title: Holy Spirit Cathedral, Minsk
geometryBasis: Native cathedral way 538208752 and twenty explicitly tagged parts establish the entrance wall, both tower plans and setbacks, aisle and nave elevations, and polygonal apse.
sectionBasis: Three May 2019 Qualla originals constrain the facade tier heights, dark belfry openings, spire profile, green sheet roofs and arched portal. Native height tags set primary section levels. Spire finials, ornament, exact stone steps and the unseen rear fenestration are estimated.
limitations: The model depicts the May 2019 cathedral exterior. The adjacent convent and the interior are outside the model scope. Rear fenestration, portal iconography, belfry interiors and the small cross finials are simplified.

Original provider terrain remains unchanged. Local grade and threshold are approximate. Four remote raster outliers near the northwest review edge are retained in the independent source field. They are well outside the building and its entrance.
